messages:
Maria (release-eng): thinking out loud — can we add a tiny set of first-class helpers to deploy-bot for quick rollbacks, pinning, and a release-notes scaffold? would cut the noise during change windows.

Ashwin (eng-tools): yes please. examples? are you picturing slash commands or subcommands on existing /deploy?

Maria (release-eng): prefer subcommands on /deploy so nothing new to learn. rough idea: `/deploy pin <service> <version> --reason` and `/deploy rollback <service> --to <version|last-good> --announce`. and a `/deploy notes generate --template basic` that spits out a markdown release-notes draft.

Olivia (sre): pin/rollback flags need to map to our traffic routing and canary policies. if rollback triggers a canary we should auto-insert a safety-window check. also: perms — require release-engineers or above.

Ashwin (eng-tools): sketching quick CLI snippets:```
# pin a version for api-gateway
/deploy pin api-gateway v2026.03.12 --reason "db migration safe"

# rollback to last known good for frontend
/deploy rollback frontend --to last-good --announce "incident #1234 follow-up"

# generate release notes draft from commit range
/deploy notes generate api-gateway --since v2026.02.01 --template minimal
```
These would call the same infra actions we run from CI, just with safety checks and audit annotation.

deploy-bot: Thanks! I logged an action: create-deploy-helper-proposal in repo deploy-scripts. Owner: @Ashwin.

Kenji (eng): for the notes template, can we include tokenized fields so PMs can quickly fill: `- What changed: %CHANGES%`, `- Rollout windows: %WINDOWS%`, `- Risk: %RISK%`. also auto-attach relevant k8s manifests or helm diff if available.

Tess (product): +1 on the templated notes — makes release checklist handoffs faster. can we include a checkbox list: QA signoff, feature flag state, monitoring links?

Maria (release-eng): yep. proposal checklist in PR: 1) implement subcommands with RBAC 2) safety-window confirmation modal before rollback 3) notes generator with two templates (minimal, full) 4) audit log + automatic changelog entry 5) dry-run mode that shows actions without executing.

Ashwin (eng-tools): I'll prototype the slash handlers this week. question: should the rollback command auto-create a postmortem stub when used with `--incident`? could save time.

Olivia (sre): auto-create PM stub only if `--incident` provided. otherwise ask for an optional `--followup` flag to attach a notes link. Also add a rate-limit guard to prevent accidental mass rollbacks (per-team semaphore).

Maria (release-eng): sounds good. Ashwin, can you open the PR and add the example templates (markdown + checklist) and a small e2e test against staging? label `release-helper/poC`.

Ashwin (eng-tools): will do. opening PR in a few hours and pinging both ops & release.

Kenji (eng): small suggestion — for `pin` do `--expires` so pins don't linger forever. default 30 days.

Maria (release-eng): yes. default expiry + a reminder 3 days before expiry.

Tess (product): :thumbsup: happy to review notes templates.

Olivia (sre): I'll add the safety-window gating to canary controller, then call into deploy-bot hook.

deploy-bot: Action recorded: PR #456 (deploy-scripts) created by Ashwin (eng-tools) — title: "deploy-bot: quick pin/rollback/notes helpers (PoC)"

Maria (release-eng): great, thanks team. if we can keep the UI modal minimal and defaults safe we should reduce friction during busy windows. will add rollout playbook snippets to the PR.

Ashwin (eng-tools): PR link: https://github.com/redwood/deploy-scripts/pull/456 — putting test plan in description. ping me for pairing on the modal.

Kenji (eng): will try the staging flow tomorrow.
